highlights.title: Stolen at the buzzer
highlights.text: ZC (Three Alive Kings) held #1 for 10 straight weeks, from week 3 through week 12 — only for Masten (MILF) to surge from 3rd to 1st in the final stretch and take the actual championship right at the finish line.

highlights.title: Bridesmaid, twice
highlights.text: BB finished runner-up in the money again this year — same result as 2021 — despite leading the league with 4 weekly high scores both seasons. Never the champion, always in the mix.

highlights.title: Feast or famine
highlights.text: Knees posted the single lowest score of the entire season (66.64, week 10) while mired in last place — then somehow won the week 14 high-scorer bonus just four weeks later.

highlights.title: Best offense, no ring
highlights.text: BB (lord) actually led the league in points per game (131.5) — higher than champion Masten's 124.5 — but finished only 4th, a reminder that raw scoring and winning it all aren't the same thing.
